lead: A `[[check]]`'s `want` string can be one its tool never prints when the finding count is zero.
body: Stage 5 wanted `none -- every carried-gaps owner is live or struck` from `python tools/playbook.py --check`, whose carried-gaps section sat inside an `if rows:` with no empty branch, so fixing every row made the section vanish rather than say `none` and the check stayed red over correct data. When a `want` line is still absent after the data is right, read the tool's printer for that heading before re-reading your own edit.
